div.head: Hl 9
div.ab: Gif he ðonne byrigan forwærne, XII scillingas agylde þam cyninge, ⁊ sio se sacy swa open swa hio ær wes.
Gif he ðonne byrigan forwærne, XII scillingas agylde þam cyninge, ⁊ sio seo sacy swa open swa hio ær wes.
Gif he ðonne byrigan forwærne, XII scillingas agylde þam cyninge, ⁊ sio se[o] sacy swa open swa hio ær wes.
Wenn er aber einen Bürgen verweigert, gelte er dem Könige 12 Schillinge; und es sei die [Rechtsstreit]sache so offen wie sie zuvor [vor der Weigerung] war.
But if he refuses a surety, let him pay the king 12 shillings; and let the [lawsuit] matter be as open as it was before [before the refusal].
If, however, he refuses to provide a surety, he shall pay 12 shillings to the king, and the suit shall be considered as open as it was before.
If he then refuses him surety, he is to pay 12 shillings to the king, and the suit is to remain as open as it was before.
If he then refuses surety, let him pay 12 shillings to the king, and the matter shall be as open as it was before.

note.seg: Die Klage ist ergangen, aber Beklagter weigert, Einlassung in den Prozess zu verbürgen
The accusation has been made, but the defendant refuses to give security for joining issue in the suit

Das Kentische Strafgeldfixum (s. d. Gl 3. a. 4. 5) und Grundzahl des Busssystems; Brunner Forsch. GDR 482; dieselbe Schillingsumme für Nichterscheinen des Beklagten in Lex Baiuwar. 13, 2; vgl. Alam. 41, 3

The fixed Kentish fine (see that word in Gl 3. a. 4. 5) and the base number of the system of compensations; Brunner Forsch. GDR 482; the same sum in shillings for non-appearance of the defendant in Lex Baiuwar. 13, 2; cf. Alam. 41, 3
Das y in sacy bezeichnet spätestes Agsä.
The y in sacy indicates the very latest A.-S.
Die Klage und bei Bürgschaftsweigerung die Geldstrafe wird also wiederholt, bis Beklagter Bürgen stellt
The accusation, and, on refusal of surety, the fine, is thus repeated until the defendant provides a surety
